title: Government asks Meta and TikTok to remove flood misinformation and scam QR codes
body: Nepal's government has asked Meta and TikTok to remove graphic flood content, AI-generated videos and scam donation QR codes that have been circulating since the disaster, the Kathmandu Post reports.
Give only through the channels listed on this page, or the government's own portal at pmdrf.nchl.com.np. A donation QR code shared on social media is not verified unless it leads there.
